name: memory-setup
description: Enable and configure Moltbot/Clawdbot memory search for persistent context. Use when setting up memory, fixing "goldfish brain," or helping users configure memorySearch in their config. Covers MEMORY.
descriptionZh: 启用并配置 Moltbot/Clawdbot 记忆搜索以实现持久上下文。适用于初始化记忆、解决“金鱼脑”问题或协助用户配置 memorySearch。涵盖 MEMORY.md、日志记录及向量搜索设置。

en.tagline: Set up persistent memory search for Moltbot/Clawdbot
en.summary: This skill sets up memory search for Moltbot and Clawdbot agents. It covers the config block, a workspace layout with MEMORY.md and daily logs, and agent instructions for recalling stored context. It helps an agent answer questions about past work instead of starting from nothing each session.
problem: Without memory, the agent forgets everything between sessions. Users repeat questions, re-explain preferences, and lose track of project history.
With this setup enabled, the agent searches MEMORY.md, the memory folder and past session transcripts before it answers. It can then recall earlier decisions, known preferences and project status.
fit: Setting up memory search for a new Moltbot or Clawdbot workspace
Fixing an agent that does not recall earlier conversations
Adding a memorySearch block to an existing config file
unfit: Users who do not run Moltbot or Clawdbot
Setups that need an embedding provider but have no API key and do not want to use the local provider
steps: Add a `memorySearch` block to `clawdbot.json` or `moltbot.json` and choose an embedding provider: `voyage`, `openai` or `local`.
Create `MEMORY.md` in the workspace root and a `memory/` folder with `logs`, `projects`, `groups` and `system` subfolders.
Fill `MEMORY.md` with sections for the user, active projects, decisions and lessons, and preferences.
Keep daily notes in `memory/logs/YYYY-MM-DD.md` using the time-based section format in the skill.
Add a Memory Recall section to AGENTS.md that tells the agent to run `memory_search` and `memory_get` before answering questions about past work.
Restart the gateway with `clawdbot gateway restart`, then ask about a past topic to check that the agent searches memory.

zh.tagline: 为 Moltbot/Clawdbot 配置持久记忆搜索
zh.summary: 这个技能用于为 Moltbot 和 Clawdbot 的智能体配置记忆搜索。它包括配置项、带有 MEMORY.md 和每日日志的工作区结构，以及让智能体调用已存储上下文的指令。配置后，智能体回答关于过往工作的问题时，不必每次从零开始。
problem: 没有记忆时，智能体在会话之间会忘掉所有内容。用户需要重复提问、重新说明偏好，项目进展也容易断档。
启用这套配置后，智能体在回答前会先搜索 MEMORY.md、记忆目录和过往会话记录。它可以回忆之前的决定、已知的偏好以及项目状态。
fit: 为新的 Moltbot 或 Clawdbot 工作区设置记忆搜索
修复智能体无法回忆早前对话的问题
在现有配置文件中添加 memorySearch 配置块
unfit: 不运行 Moltbot 或 Clawdbot 的用户
需要嵌入服务商但没有 API 密钥，又不打算使用本地服务商的环境
steps: 在 `clawdbot.json` 或 `moltbot.json` 中添加 `memorySearch` 配置块，并选择嵌入服务商：`voyage`、`openai` 或 `local`。
在工作区根目录创建 `MEMORY.md`，并创建 `memory/` 目录，其下包含 `logs`、`projects`、`groups` 和 `system` 子目录。
在 `MEMORY.md` 中填写用户信息、进行中的项目、决策与经验教训以及偏好等章节。
按照技能中的时间分段格式，将每日记录保存在 `memory/logs/YYYY-MM-DD.md` 中。
在 AGENTS.md 中添加 Memory Recall 章节，要求智能体在回答过往工作相关问题前先运行 `memory_search` 和 `memory_get`。
使用 `clawdbot gateway restart` 重启网关，然后询问一个过往话题，检查智能体是否会搜索记忆。
